layers.message: Initial expense API with API key roles
Start STANDARDS cycle for CSV export

graderOnly: At the start of the run .standards/CONTEXT.md does not exist, so no usable project-level context baseline exists; this is the initial brownfield audit of the first cycle.
Active Work.Request is to add CSV export of expenses to the existing expense tracker; Scope, Architecture, and Development are NONE.

The repository contains no CSV or export code; the relevant existing areas are the expense list route (filters, owner scoping), the monthly report route, src/auth.js role rules, src/format.js money formatting, and the integer-cents convention.

Established commands are `npm start` and `npm test` (package.json scripts, README.md, AGENTS.md); `npm test` runs `node --test` over four explicit test files and passes. Configuration uses the environment variable names PORT, API_KEYS, and DATA_FILE.
AGENTS.md holds pre-existing project instructions (no third-party dependencies, integer cents, ISO dates, auth on every route, run npm test) outside the STANDARDS managed block.
`npm start` starts a long-running HTTP server; running it is not needed to establish the baseline.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. layers/00-project (pre-install commit): a dependency-free Node 22 ESM expense-tracker API (src/server.js, router.js, http.js, auth.js, store.js, validate.js, format.js, routes/expenses.js), sample data, node:test tests, README, .gitignore, and a pre-existing AGENTS.md with project instructions the installer merges with. layers/10-reports (pre-install commit): adds the monthly report route and its test, updating router, README, and the test script. layers/50-cycle: STATE.md for the first cycle: AUDITING, STANDARD, Id add-csv-export-of-expenses-to-the-20260924T090000Z-3e9a6b10 (slug as cycle.mjs would derive it from the request), Request 'Add CSV export of expenses to the expense tracker.', all paths NONE, Handoff INITIAL (first cycle keeps INITIAL), recovery and obligations inactive. MODE.md stays the installer's BROWNFIELD. No CONTEXT.md and no records. Utterance is just 'Continue.' per the catalog, dropping the prompt's leaked instructions.
